purpose: Zero-step CPU Cubic dynamic-wall dispatch component, extracted from the fully read retained upl_p3_wall_wave_harness_r2.cpp initialization and Component().

seed.transformation: Copy BI4 byte-for-byte, copy XML changing only parameter Kernel value 2 to 1. No GenCase or resampling. Retain all 1280 original IDs/coordinates/normals and h/dp=1.8.
seed.geometry: 32x32 soil lattice between two parallel FreeSlip mDBC planes, 128 fixed markers on each face, tangential Z periodic copies.
seed.historical_h_tag: The old seed directory and stored dt comment are provenance only. No half-step or time-integration operation is performed.

checks.actual_initialization: LoadConfig, LoadCaseParticles, ConfigDomain, ConfigRunMode, InitRunCpu and FreePartsInit, using the original private fixture flags. Retain the old Reset() initial component field assignment before taking the initial state; no uninitialized correction-matrix contents are consumed.
checks.actual_three_stages: ComputeDynamicPoreWallStateCpu, ComputeDynamicPoreWallMatrixCpu and ComputeDynamicPoreWallAccelerationCpu, each once at coincident targets and once with exact Dp/8 normal offsets.
checks.fields: Original affine J, float p, derivative velocity, all six double stress components, all nine correction-matrix components and acceleration; physical fixed velocity, tangent velocity and active mDBC mode. Native physical26, C and Ace must be byte-unchanged by the three stages.
checks.original_budgets: condition=max(1,||M||inf*||inverse(M)||inf), using actual J-weighted Cubic W. td=32768*DBL_EPSILON*condition, tf=64*FLT_EPSILON*condition. J<=2td, p<=256tf, derivative-v<=tf, Ace<=tf, sigma<=128td, C<=4td. No budget widening.
checks.condition_at_zero: Condition estimation needs only W; GetKernel_Wab<Cubic> avoids evaluating the unused radial Fac at an exact coincident target. Production stage uses its existing rr2==0 guard.
checks.counts: 2 cases, 512 native wall rows, 256 exact noncoincident targets; all native IDs and true fixed planes verified. All geometry/ID/normal bytes and initial native physical26 restored at completion.
checks.output: Fresh helper/result under tests/outputs/upl_cubic_cpu_wall_r1, four CSVs (two component error tables and soil/fixed ID tables), completion.json; exact typed Popen exits in tests/logs with the same tag.

execution_plan.build: After root reads the source, compile one new helper and link all 85 non-main current upl_cubic_r1 DebugCPU objects. Do not execute an old wrapper.
execution_plan.one_attempt: One actual component run only. Failure is retained; no automatic retry.
execution_plan.identity_policy: Use current source/input/runtime/canonical size and mtime before/after, reuse existing source/build receipts, and hash only the newly generated helper exe once. Do not require historical prebuild document mtimes after root's documented review updates. No old object/raw SHA scans.

limits: This CPU component isolates Cubic dispatch at retained h/dp=1.8. The separate GPU component is the source of any actual paper h/dp=1.2 evidence. No copied wave modes, force audits, Darcy-rate comparison, trajectory, energy, half-step, Cryer run, solver main, formal input edit or physical acceptance is included.
